$KRKNF is approved to close a massive drone tech acquisition.

The Covelya acquisition has been lit by regulators and hits officially July 2, opening powerful combined guidance from management.

The Krak is +8.3% today while other defense stocks are dead money.

Let me lay out the math again on this deal, because you have to compute on your own for now.

THE DEAL

Kraken announced Covelya on March 3 for C$615M (C$480M cash, C$135M stock). The cash was funded through a C$350M bought deal priced at C$8.50. That's where institutions committed. The stock trades below that today!

WHAT COVELYA IS

A 50 year old UK subsea tech group. Six subsidiaries: Sonardyne (acoustic navigation, already inside Anduril's seabed sentry/DIVE-LD), EIVA (autonomy software), Forcys (naval integration), Wavefront (threat-detection sonar), Voyis (underwater optics), Chelsea (environmental sensors). ~750 engineers, ~24% EBITDA margins.

Kraken was the power and sonar inside undersea drones. Now it owns the navigation, comms, and optical layers too. The internal stack, regardless of who wins the hull.

COMBINED ENTITY (forward run-rate)

Revenue: C$430M+
Adj. EBITDA: C$108M+ (~25% margin)

THE COMP DISCONNECT

On forward EV/Sales, $KRKNF pro forma sits around 7x.
$RCAT and $ONDS trade 20-30x trailing on zero or negative EBITDA.

$KTOS and $AVAV sit at 4-6x, but run 6% and negative EBITDA margins.

Kraken does 30%+ growth at a 60% gross margin and is already profitable. You are paying a discount for the better business.

CATALYSTS

TSX main board uplisting could happen before EOY. Institutional ownership is near 20%, held down by mandates that block TSX-V names. The uplisting removes that gate. Funds that structurally cannot own it today get to buy. Mechanical demand hits the float.

An Anduril US Navy or Five Eyes UUV multi-billion dollar program award. Locks in multi year revenue visibility. This is what re-rates the multiple from 7x to 10x EV/sales.

A US battery facility is announced. Forward visibility into nine figures of Anduril Replicator volume. Content per vehicle goes up.

PRICE TARGET

Base case PT set up is clean.

Combined 2027 revenue lands near C$550M. Put 9x forward EV/Sales on that, still under the pure plays and earned by the margin profile, and you get roughly C$13 on PNG.

For $KRKNF, the OTC ticker, that's about US$9.50. Roughly 65% from here.

Anyhow I find it hard to believe the multiple gets much more aggressive on Anduril subsea orders and more factory capacity, creating a possible 2-3x over the next 12 months.
